role: Product Manager / Marketing Lead / Business Development
image_alt: Portrait of Hung Nguyen at an esports event
full_story:
I’m Hung, but call me CK. Over 7+ years I have worked across marketing, business development, and product and project management, mostly in gaming, esports and digital products, and I’m now looking to bring the same approach to other industries.

I started with hands-on marketing and user growth in domestic and international markets with Garena’s Free Fire team, one of the leading companies in global gaming and esports. I then moved into strategic business development and, later, product management at VTV Live / ON Live, a young, startup-like team bringing esports into Vietnam’s mainstream media.

I love researching how users live. Empathy is the cornerstone of intuitive, forward-thinking products.

**Open to:** Product Manager, Product Marketing, Marketing Lead and Business Development roles across industries: tech, media, consumer and digital products, as well as gaming and esports.
summary: 7+ years in product, marketing and business development, from Garena Free Fire to VTV Live (ON Live). Open to roles across industries.
Product, marketing and business development in one profile: I connect users, partnerships and revenue.
Proof: 380K+ MAU on ON Live, USD 500K value-in-kind Riot media-rights deal, 130M impressions in Pakistan.
